availableVersions.label: v3.8.7 (Verified Operational Release)
availableVersions.description: Table 2.2 Sectoral Advisory Matrix redesign, KMD CAP active vs expired filtering, and Subtab 2.4 whitespace optimization: Replaced awkward 3+1 grid cards in Section 2.4 with a structured 4-sector advisory matrix table, eliminating orphaned whitespace and cutting vertical height by over 50% while preserving all statutory citations and operational directives.
highlights: Table 2.2 Structured Sectoral Matrix: Replaced awkward 3-column + 1-orphaned-box grid with an authentic 3-column, 4-row structured matrix table ('Sector & Advisory Scope', 'Priority Operational Triggers & Actions', 'Lead Institutional Partners'), cutting vertical scrolling space by >50%.

Elimination of Wasted Space in Section 2.4: Unified Agriculture, Pastoralism, Water, and Disaster Risk Management into a continuous, dense institutional decision table with color-accented indicator bars and dedicated lead agency metadata cards.

KMD CAP Expiration Verification (Section 2.4): Enforced strict client-side expiration checks (expires > now) on KMD CAP severe weather advisories, preventing expired Long Rains 2026 bulletins from displaying as active warnings.

Official 'Normal Monitoring' Operational Banner: When 0 active alerts are in effect for a county, renders a verified green operational card confirming 'Status: Normal Monitoring' with direct links to meteo.go.ke/weather-warnings.
Historical Advisory Archive: Preserved past bulletins in an institutional archive drawer explicitly designated for retrospective auditing of MAM 2026 bulletins with EXPIRED badges.
Figure 2.2 Analogue Year Dropdown & Table 2.1 Matrix: Streamlined Figure 2.2 controls into a compact dropdown and structured Table 2.1 outcome matrix.

categories.title: Early Warning & Operational Integrity
items: Strict CAP Expiration Filtering: Guaranteed only unexpired, currently active KMD severe weather warnings appear in the primary operational status card.
Normal Monitoring State: Authoritative green banner displaying zero-alert confirmation aligned with official KMD meteorological portal.
Historical Archive Drawer: Auditable catalog of expired MAM 2026 bulletins with explicit season attribution and EXPIRED tags.

categories.title: UI/UX & Layout Architecture
items: De-duplicated Section 2.3 Controls: Compact 1-row control bar replacing 8 large buttons and 3 radio options.
Structured HTML Matrix Table: Built dedicated 4-row tabular outcome matrix for Table 2.1 with responsive horizontal scrolling.
Independent Sub-Tab System: Converted Section 1 and Section 2 into discrete subtab panes with top sub-tab bars and sticky sub-navigation integration.
Whitespace Reduction: Formatted Section 2.1 (3 cards) and Section 2.3 (4 cards) into single-row responsive grids.

availableVersions.label: v3.7.0 (Archived Operational Release)
availableVersions.description: Operational milestone release featuring 45-year leave-one-out historical hindcast skill cross-validation (RPSS & contingency matrices; Decision D56), automated CI release assertions, Handle API academic DOI registration verification, and interactive methodological foldouts across all 22 figures (Decision D57).
highlights: Analogue Outlook LOOCV Skill Verification: 45-year retrospective leave-one-out cross-validation (1981–2025) across all 47 counties and both seasons. Surfaces Ranked Probability Skill Score (RPSS), modal hit rate (+ gain vs 33% climatology), extreme flood resolution (BSS Wet), severe false alarm rates, and interactive 3x3 contingency matrix (Decision D56).
Interactive Methodological Foldouts (KE-13): Restored and authored interactive 'About this plot' methodology expanders across all 22 figures in Sections 1–4 with accessible details styling.

Automated CI Release Assertions Suite: Comprehensive automated test suite (tools/ci_release_assertions.py) validating academic DOI registrations via the International DOI Foundation Handle REST API, dataset schemas, freshness horizons, and cross-dataset consistency across all 48 spatial units (Decision D57).

Cross-Tab Data Integrity Verification: Playwright test suite (tests/test_crosstab_integrity.mjs) asserting exact mutual numerical consistency between Section 0 Executive Brief, Section 2 Outlook, Section 3 Climate Evidence, and Section 4 Impacts with 0 console errors.

Executive County Brief & 2-Page Print/PDF Export: 1-screen actionable synthesis in Section 0 with live planetary drivers (RONI/DMI), statutory KMSA advisory mandate, analogue consensus odds with Wilson 95% confidence intervals, retrospective skill tag, top 3 historical precedents, and 4-sector anticipatory action matrix formatted strictly for 2-page print export (Decision D55).
Figure 3.1B Consecutive-Season Sequence View: pairs OND(Y−1) → MAM(Y) to track dual-season failure trajectories and unbroken pasture deficit runs (Decision D53).
Comprehensive External Audit Remediation: resolved all 15 identified code/data defects and sanitized 126 factual claims from Dr. Aniruddha Ghosh's review.
Official KNBS Census Benchmarks: aligned population exposure to 2019 Census enumerated headcounts and 2026 projections across all 47 counties (Decision D51).

categories.title: New Features & Visualizations
items: Analogue Outlook LOOCV Skill Verification: Surfaced 45-year retrospective hindcast skill panel and expandable 3x3 confusion matrix in Figure 2.1 and Section 0 Brief (Decision D56).
Interactive Methodological Foldouts: Restored 'About this plot (data & methodology)' expanders across all 22 figures in Sections 1–4 with custom styling (Decision D57 / KE-13).

Executive County Brief & Citable 2-Page Print/PDF Export: Comprehensive 1-screen briefing document directly addressing County CIDP officers, climate-finance proposal writers (GCF/AF), and County Disaster Risk Management Committees (CDRMC) formatted strictly for 2-page A4 output (Decision D55).

Figure 3.1B Consecutive Seasonal Sequences & Compounding Runs: Pairs production years Y = OND(Y−1) + MAM(Y) per official KNBS/HarvestStat conventions, displays 2-cell domino strips with continuous diverging z colormaps, tracks unbroken sub-normal runs, highlights double-failure emergencies, and correlates with staple crop yield deficits (Decision D53).

Figure 4.2B Long-Term Crop & Climate Historical Response: Integrates HarvestStat county maize and bean production/yield (1990–2024), 2002–2014 seasonal reporting gap overlays, and CHIRPS planting-season tercile strips (Decision D40).
Figure 1.1 Responsive Side-by-Side Commodity Panels: Dynamic multi-panel layout rendering Crop and Livestock balances side-by-side without vertical clipping or overflow (Decision D48).

categories.title: Data Ingestion & Integrity
items: Automated CI Release Assertions: Continuous data integrity script asserting schemas, row bounds, and freshness across served parquets (Decision D57).
Canonical DOI Handle Registration: Verified 100% resolution of all 18 academic literature citations via the Handle REST API and corrected Saji 1999 citation to 10.1038/43854.
Tier 16 Exposure Denominators & Demographic Re-Leveling: Aligned Section 1 demographics to official KNBS 2019 Census enumerated headcount and 2026 projections across all 47 counties (Decision D51).
Official Sub-County Universe: Labeled adm2 boundaries as official IEBC parliamentary constituencies (290 units), documenting boundary universe divergence from KNBS's 345 administrative sub-counties.
NOAA CPC JAS 2026 Ocean Drivers: Verified real-time NOAA CPC ingestion (+1.69 °C RONI, +2.56 °C Niño 3.4), replacing stale lead-ins and updating drivers parquets with 30/30 freshness assertions.

categories.title: Science, Teleconnections & Methodology
items: Leave-One-Out Historical Hindcast Verification: Rigorous 45-year retrospective cross-validation (1981–2025) evaluating analogue outlook skill per county and season (RPSS, BSS, HSS, false-alarm rates; Decision D56).

Empirical Non-Parametric Rainfall Quantiles: Replaced parametric Gaussian normal bands with empirical P10, P33, P67, P90 quantiles from 1991–2020 WMO baseline, eliminating negative rainfall thresholds (Decision D43).

Unified Metric Space for Analogue Matching: Mapped IRI Niño 3.4 plume median into RONI space before Euclidean distance calculation against historical OND RONI, eliminating inflated anomaly alerts (Decision D42).
Dual-Window Ocean Driver Formulation: Documented Pacific vs Indian Ocean empirical baseline standard deviations, clarifying variance ratios govern SST, not rainfall (Decision D44).
Western-V Gradient Clarification: Aligned MAM Western-V gradient definition with Funk et al. (2019, 2023) and replaced 'persistent' droughts with 'more frequent' droughts.

categories.title: Institutional Alignment & Governance
items: Institutional Realignment: Kenya Meteorological Service Authority (KMSA) under Meteorology Act No. 7 of 2026; County Disaster Risk Management Committees (CDRMC) under NDRM Act 2026; expanded NDMA warning stages to all 6 operational phases.

Tone & Authority Sanitization: Removed pseudo-statutory language ('Anti-AI Slop', 'statutory legal baselines', 'audited statutory indicators') and internal developer ticket codes (Decisions D44, D52).

Verified Literature Citations: Replaced defective/hallucinated academic citations with verified Crossref DOIs (Bauer-Marschallinger 2022, Wagner 2026, Funk 2019/2023 Western-V, Gamoyo 2015 rewritten).
Operational Tool Links: Converted Table 2.3 into active hyperlinks pointing to live KMSA, NDMA, KRCS, ICPAC, KFSSG, and NDOC portals.
